description: Standardized CAN Bus & IMU Telemetry Data Contract for Industrial Vehicles in Safety Backfire Research.

signals.purpose: Global chronological baseline linking vehicle physical control states to video frame capture.
signals.failure_mode: Timestamp gap > 20ms or clock jump causes temporal gate G4 invalidation.

signals.purpose: Verify vehicle approach velocity, deceleration profile, and absolute cessation of movement (dead stop verification).
signals.failure_mode: Zero-speed drift or wheel-lock slip falsely reporting stationary vehicle.

signals.purpose: Detect wheel lockup, traction loss, differential braking, and rotational slippage during abrupt maneuvers.
signals.failure_mode: Encoder pulse dropout under wet/dusty warehouse floor conditions.

signals.purpose: Quantify braking onset rate, peak deceleration force, and stopping dynamics for Gate G1 intervention confirmation.
signals.failure_mode: Sensor vibration noise from uneven floor joints masking true deceleration onset.

signals.purpose: Definitively confirm driver or automatic safety brake actuation, distinguishing active intervention from nominal coasting.
signals.failure_mode: Digital microswitch bounce or contact corrosion delaying state change flag.

signals.purpose: Measure physical braking force applied to calipers, validating severity and proportionality of emergency intervention.
signals.failure_mode: Transducer drift requiring periodic zero-pressure calibration.

signals.purpose: Detect steering wheel rotation and evasive swerving toward secondary zones, establishing lateral trajectory redirection.
signals.failure_mode: Centering offset drift falsely reporting lateral redirection when driving straight.

signals.purpose: Measure instantaneous vehicle angular turning velocity, confirming physical chassis swerve into cross-aisle coordinates.
signals.failure_mode: Thermal bias drift in MEMS gyroscope during extended facility shifts.

signals.purpose: Verify accelerator pedal release, establishing human or autonomous reaction time prior to brake application.
signals.failure_mode: Potentiometer deadband obscuring partial throttle release.
